capabilities: launch Codex CLI from a ribbon icon or command
open a terminal in the current vault directory
pass a configurable startup prompt to Codex
show a compact launcher panel in the right sidebar
extras: Manual/local install only (no community plugin store listing); manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff; desktop-only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to start an external AI CLI session rooted in the vault with vault context passed along.

relations.evidence: Codex Workflow is a plugin for launching Codex CLI from the current vault.

summary: Launcher that opens Codex CLI in a terminal at the current vault directory, with a configurable startup prompt and sidebar panel.
